svg.text: 2. CHOOSING A PORT, CHOOSING A LINK: TELLING THEM APART
A port chosen: the port is what lights, filled amber; its links stay as they are (the rest fades). A link chosen: the link is what lights;
its two ports only get an amber edge. Amber is the LCD's. Ports are ears from the block's edge (3 · C).
A PORT CHOSEN · THE SAME WITH EVERY WAY OF SHOWING A LINK
Left: an output chosen (output_FL), its one link lit. Right: an input chosen (playback_FL),
both links into it lit; the ports at their other ends stay as they are.
A LINK CHOSEN · A · THICKER, WITH AN AMBER CORE
The link keeps its colour, twice as thick, an amber line along its middle.
The chosen link turns amber. Plain; while it is chosen, the colour of where it comes from is gone.
A LINK CHOSEN · C · OUTLINED, AS A ROUTE ON A MAP
Its colour inside an amber edge, on a dark casing: stands out over other links crossing it.
A LINK CHOSEN · D · RUNNING DASHES
Its colour with amber dashes running along it, from the output to the input (moving in the app; still here).
3 · C. A PORT IS AN EAR FROM THE EDGE: ITS NAME CLICKS AS ITS JACK DOES
playback_FL: an end of the chosen link
